items.title: Irving Azoff’s Music Artists Coalition joins Cate Blanchett and CAA on AI licensing brief in New York Times’ case against OpenAI
items.summary: RIAA, NMPA, ASCAP, BMI, and five other music organizations filed a proposed brief of their own, formally backing the plaintiffs. Source

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is doubling down on its Apple subpoena push, arguing that the information being sought – about Apple Music’s major label licensing talks, “anti-AI deal terms,” and more – is central to its fair use and copyright misuse arguments. The AI music platform took aim at Apple’s motion to quash in a 24-page opposition fil…

items.title: Elvis Presley IP Owners Sue Anthropic Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Elvis Presley’s rightsholders have sued Anthropic with allegations of copyright infringement over 274 of his songs used to train AI models without permission. AI company Anthropic faces yet another copyright infringement lawsuit, this time filed by the owners of Elvis Presley’s music in a case that accuses the company…

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: As Suno fends off an ever-growing number of music industry copyright complaints, a raft of subpoena showdowns – including the AI platform’s own document and deposition demands – are now in full swing. Does that mean game-changing disclosures are on the horizon? Time will tell, though the current evidence suggests yes.…

items.title: Anthropic sued over Elvis catalog — and the 274-song copyright battle shows the AI industry's 'fair use' excuses are getting old
UMG, Sony, and DistroKid tell court they are ‘working on a resolution’ in dispute over AI music data for Suno case
items.summary: The two majors are seeking data from DistroKid on how many of the tracks it delivers to streaming services are flagged as AI-generated. Source

items.title: GEMA on AI: ‘The most important thing is we get an output remuneration’
items.summary: Having won an initial ruling against Suno in Germany, collecting society GEMA is considering its future moves in AI music, both in terms of lawsuits and policy lobbying. tip.title: Antes de firmar, revisa la reversión de derechos
tip.body: La pregunta clave de cualquier contrato no es cuánto te dan hoy, sino cuándo y cómo recuperas tu obra. Si no hay cláusula de reversión, estás cediendo por el plazo completo.

tip.title: Before signing, check the reversion clause
tip.body: The key question in any deal isn't what you get today —it's when and how you get your work back. With no reversion clause, you're assigning for the full term.
